description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: Damaged Goods Claims & Recovery

eval_cases.input: What is our total carrier damage claim recovery percentage across FedEx, UPS, and USPS over the last 30 days?
What is the average dispatch lead time (in hours) for customer replacement orders following damage approval?
Which damage types (e.g. crushed box, liquid leakage, broken glass) are most frequently reported by customers?
What is the total salvage recovery revenue recovered from secondary market disposition this month?
What are standard freight and parcel carrier damage claim reimbursement rates and timelines in retail e-commerce?
